meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: Claude 可以把一张多智能体 DAG 定义存成命名 JSON 文件,之后按名字加载并重新运行,不用每次重贴定义;加载时还会填充 {{key}}、{{date}} 等占位符,并给 run key 加上时间戳。
howto.when: 当你想保存一张 DAG、运行已存好的 DAG,或反复调度同一张多智能体图时触发;只写全新图时先看 mass-ulw。

say.text: 把这张图存成 nightly-audit,然后跑一次确认。
say.note: 写入 ~/.omo/dags 并立即启动一次运行。
key 会加 UTC 时间戳,得到一次全新运行。

say.text: 用 suffix 20260818 重新跑 nightly-audit。
say.note: key 固定,复用同一次运行。

howto.what_en: Claude can save a multi-agent DAG definition as a named JSON file and re-run it by name instead of pasting the definition each time. Placeholders such as {{key}} and {{date}} are filled at load, and the run key gets a timestamp.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to save a DAG, run an already-saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly. For authoring a brand-new graph, read mass-ulw first.

say_en.text: Save this graph as nightly-audit, then run it once to confirm.
say_en.note: Writes to ~/.omo/dags and starts a run.
Rotates the key with a UTC timestamp, so it's a fresh run.
Fixed key reuses that run; new days get new runs.
